people.name: Azariah
people.line: One of Daniel's companions, survived the fiery furnace

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

people.name: Hananiah
people.line: One of Daniel's three friends in Babylon.

people.name: Mishael
people.line: A Jewish exile in Babylon, friend of Daniel.

translations.web: Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon; but Daniel was in the king’s gate.
translations.bsb: And at Daniel’s request, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to manage the province of Babylon, while Daniel remained in the king’s court.
translations.kjv: Then Daniel requested of the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel sat in the gate of the king.
translations.asv: And Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel was in the gate of the king.
